meta.title: Denver/Arvada Toddler Outing Spots

sources_scrubbed.name: Colorado Mama Life
sources_scrubbed.note: Angelica Quintanilla — family adventures + raw motherhood; added from FB reel share 2026-10-01

meta.scrub_window: ~90 days of Days.in.denver beehiiv (Mar–Oct 2026) + Fall guide; CKAR 10-park list; CKE Belleview; IG/FB captions largely login-walled
meta.notes: Why-notes paraphrased/quoted from source captions and newsletters. Drive times are rough estimates from Arvada 80004; verify in Google Maps. Do not invent venues — every pin cites a named source. Seasonal spots kept if still relevant for fall 2026 or evergreen otherwise.

places.name: CSU Spur
places.why: Completely free and open to the public — mock vet clinic, play kitchen, water table, and hands-on spots across three buildings; feels like a children's museum without the price. 2nd Saturdays add extra activities (Days.in.denver monthly favorite).
places.hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm; 2nd Saturdays 10am–2pm; closed other Sat & Sun
places.toddler_notes: Great for ~20 months: indoor play kitchen, water table, mock vet. Free year-round (except Stock Show grounds fee).
places.drive_note: ~21 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~6.0 mi straight-line)

places.name: Apex Center (Indoor Playground)
places.why: Days.in.denver: 'basically an entire day under one roof' — indoor water park, ice rinks, climbing wall, and a FREE indoor playground for little kids (Colorado-themed with tots area ~1–3).
places.hours: Open daily; check Apex schedule for playground/pool hours
places.cost: Daily admission typically ~$10.50 kids / $12.50 adults (playground included; verify)
places.toddler_notes: Tots section — ideal for ~20 months. Right in Arvada.
places.drive_note: ~15 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~3.8 mi straight-line)

places.name: Belleview Park (Farm & Train)
places.why: Highlighted by Colorado Kids Explore and Days.in.denver: free park with playgrounds and creek; seasonal petting farm and miniature train (~$3 ages 2+, under 2 free).
source_accounts: Facebook: Colorado Kids Explore - Adventure Guide
places.hours: Park: dawn–dusk. Farm & Train: typically Memorial Day–Labor Day (~9am–3:30pm; check city)
places.toddler_notes: Under-2 free for farm/train. Creek play + playground year-round.
places.drive_note: ~41 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~12.7 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Cheyenne-Arapaho (Tsistsistas-Hinono'ei) Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Natural-themed playground (bison climber, leaf playhouse, sand play, baby swings) geared toward younger kids (~2–8) plus dog park.
places.toddler_notes: Baby swings and sand play; supervise closely.
places.drive_note: ~43 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~13.3 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Bates-Logan Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list; Days.in.denver calls it one of the most fun parks with three pump tracks, scooters/bike paths, and two playgrounds (including one for littles under 4).
places.toddler_notes: Younger kids area + inclusive features; bring a strider if ready.
places.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad (@coloradokidsarerad) — 10-park list; also Days.in.denver (@days.in.denver)
places.drive_note: ~35 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~10.8 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Washington Park
places.address: S Downing St & E Louisiana Ave area, Denver, CO 80210
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Classic Denver park with playgrounds, lakes, paths — easy picnic + play. Days.in.denver also flags the shady creek behind the north playground for early water play.
places.toddler_notes: Multiple playground areas; spacious for stroller walks.
places.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad (@coloradokidsarerad) — 10-park list; also Days.in.denver (@days.in.denver)
places.drive_note: ~30 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~9.0 mi straight-line)

places.name: City View Park
places.address: Welby / North Metro (City View Park), Adams County, CO
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Neighborhood park with multi-level play and a quieter setting.
places.toddler_notes: Quieter option north of Denver.
places.drive_note: ~24 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~6.9 mi straight-line)

places.name: La Raza Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Highland-area park with playground upgrades — solid toddler stop near N Denver.
places.toddler_notes: Good Highland/Sloan’s Lake corridor pairing.
places.drive_note: ~17 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~4.6 mi straight-line)

places.name: Paco Sanchez Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Huge radio/music-themed adventure playground (giant mic, nets, spiral slide, zipline) — often called one of Denver’s best.
places.toddler_notes: Park is HUGE — stay in toddler-friendly zones; bring a second adult if possible.
places.drive_note: ~19 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~5.1 mi straight-line)

places.name: Joseph P. Martinez Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. West Denver park with cultural playground / Phase 1 improvements.
places.toddler_notes: Pair with Sloan’s Lake / Paco Sanchez corridor.
places.drive_note: ~19 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~5.2 mi straight-line)

places.name: Sloan's Lake Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list; Days.in.denver park pick — lake + skyline, playground, pump track, paved loop for strollers/bikes.
places.toddler_notes: Watch water edges; playgrounds + open lawn good for ~20 months.
places.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad (@coloradokidsarerad) — 10-park list; also Days.in.denver (@days.in.denver)
places.drive_note: ~16 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~4.2 mi straight-line)

places.name: Central Park (playground)
places.address: Central Park neighborhood / near E Smith Rd, Denver, CO 80238
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list; Days.in.denver: one of Denver’s best playground destinations with huge modern play, climbing, open fields. Tip: start at Panda Coffee, bring scooters.
places.toddler_notes: Dedicated younger play; summer splash features when open.
places.source: Colorado Kids Are Rad (@coloradokidsarerad) — 10-park list; also Days.in.denver (@days.in.denver)
places.drive_note: ~34 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~10.4 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Wright Park
places.why: On Colorado Kids Are Rad’s 10-park list. Recently renovated: nature-based play, loop trail, shade, open lawn, dog park.
places.toddler_notes: Nature play + open lawn; freshly renovated.
places.drive_note: ~22 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~6.2 mi straight-line)

places.name: Children's Museum of Denver (Bloom + Joy Park)
places.why: Recurring Days.in.denver favorite — Bloom exhibit designed for newborn–36 months; Joy Park outdoor Colorado nature play. Featured for Mess Fest, Creative Calm, Party for the Planet, Harvest Hoot.
places.cost: Paid admission (under 1 often free; check current rates / SCFD free days)
places.toddler_notes: Bloom is purpose-built for ~20 months. Great rainy-day or cold-day option.
places.drive_note: ~18 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~4.8 mi straight-line)

places.name: DMNS Nature Play Park + Museum
places.why: Days.in.denver weekend idea: Museum of Nature & Science then Nature Play Park right behind it (climbable bighorn sheep, tunnels, water features). Curious Kids programs for ages 2–5 also featured.
places.hours: Nature Play outdoor: typically dawn–dusk free; museum hours vary
places.cost: Nature Play free; museum paid (SCFD free days / library passes)
places.toddler_notes: Outdoor Nature Play works well for toddlers without buying museum tickets.
places.drive_note: ~28 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~8.2 mi straight-line)

places.name: Denver Botanic Gardens — Mordecai Children's Garden
places.why: Days.in.denver June favorite: Children's Garden + Springmelt Stream — 'one of the best hidden gems in Denver' with water play, nature exploration, space to roam. Suited to ages ~12 months–8 years.
places.cost: Included with Botanic Gardens admission (SCFD free days)
places.toddler_notes: Digging, stream splash, natural play — messy-friendly for toddlers.
places.drive_note: ~27 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~8.0 mi straight-line)

places.name: The Urban Farm
places.why: Days.in.denver weekly favorite and June spotlight: visit goats, chickens, pigs and other farm animals at this working farm in the city. Animal meet-and-greet experiences featured.
places.toddler_notes: Slow-paced animal outing — great for ~20 months if stroller-friendly paths.
places.drive_note: ~37 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~11.4 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Clement Park (+ Columbine Library)
places.why: Days.in.denver park pick: 'total standout' with incredible playground, trails, reservoir, summer splash park. Tip: pair with Columbine Library next door for park + library day; LEGO Build & Play events.
places.hours: Park dawn–dusk; library hours vary; splash seasonal
places.cost: Free park/library; splash may have fees
places.toddler_notes: Huge playground; go early or cloudy days to avoid crowds.
places.drive_note: ~45 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~14.3 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Cook Park
places.address: 7100 E Cherry Creek South Dr, Denver, CO 80224
places.why: Days.in.denver March park pick: great for toddlers; bike Cherry Creek Trail straight to the playground. Tip: Detour Bakery pastries for a morning park picnic.
places.toddler_notes: Toddler-friendly playground + trail access.
places.drive_note: ~39 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~12.1 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Denver Rock Park
places.address: Denver Rock Park / Central Park area boulder playground (approx)
places.why: Days.in.denver March park pick: unique playground with giant climbable boulders — perfect for adventurous climbers. Closed-toe shoes a must.
places.toddler_notes: Supervise closely; rocks can be dusty/slippery. Better for confident climbers; younger toddlers may prefer nearby soft-surface parks.
places.drive_note: ~32 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~9.7 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Ralston Valley Park
places.why: Days.in.denver May creek pick in Arvada: play structures for littles and bigger kids; standout is the shallow, shady creek. Street parking only.
places.toddler_notes: Near-home Arvada gem for creek toddling + playground.
places.drive_note: ~16 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~4.1 mi straight-line)

places.name: Paul Derda Recreation Center
places.why: Days.in.denver May favorite: indoor playground FREE for kids 3 and under; family swim with zero-entry pool, toddler slides, water features, lazy river.
places.hours: Daily; check family swim / playground schedule
places.cost: Admission fees apply; indoor playground free for 3 & under (per Days.in.denver)
places.toddler_notes: Indoor playground perfect for ~20 months on cold/rainy days.
places.drive_note: ~30 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~8.8 mi straight-line)

places.name: Kids Wonder Indoor Play
places.address: Kids Wonder Indoor Play Denver metro (verify address)
places.why: Days.in.denver March favorite: indoor play with little town pretend play, climbing structures, and crawler zone for littles. Wednesdays Grandparents Day discount noted.
places.toddler_notes: Crawler zone suited to ~20 months.
places.drive_note: ~41 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~12.6 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Sweet Play (Toddler Tuesday)
places.why: Days.in.denver April weekly favorite: Toddler Tuesday discounted admission ($12) for toddlers 3 and under — great indoor option when spring weather is unpredictable.
places.toddler_notes: Discounted toddler indoor play.
places.drive_note: ~35 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~10.6 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: The Bookies Bookstore
places.why: Days.in.denver recurring favorite: Animal Cracker Story Time Tuesdays & Saturdays 10:30am — stories, crafts, songs, dancing in a lively children's bookstore.
places.hours: Store hours vary; story time Tue & Sat 10:30am
places.toddler_notes: Excellent free toddler outing; browse children's section after.
places.drive_note: ~34 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~10.5 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Tumble Haus (Highlands)
places.why: Days.in.denver March spotlight & Sept favorite: open tumble play for little kids (adults free); Happy Hour Sun/Wed/Fri 4–6pm so kids climb/tumble while parents grab coffee or wine.
places.hours: Check schedule; Happy Hour 4–6pm select days
places.toddler_notes: Soft indoor play good for ~20 months; adults free per Days.in.denver.
places.drive_note: ~16 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~4.3 mi straight-line)

places.name: Bonfire Burritos (Olde Town Arvada)
places.why: Days.in.denver July favorite: huge outdoor space with turf, toys, and room for kids to play while parents enjoy coffee and breakfast burritos — perfect for early risers near home.
places.toddler_notes: Near-home Arvada hang with dedicated kid play space.
places.drive_note: ~8 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~0.1 mi straight-line)

places.name: Wheat Ridge Recreation Center Pool
places.why: Days.in.denver Sept favorite: easy indoor activity — leisure pool with zero-depth entry, water features, kids' slide; 120-ft slide for 48"+.
places.toddler_notes: Zero-depth entry great for ~20 months with close supervision.
places.drive_note: ~12 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~2.6 mi straight-line)

places.name: Lookout Mountain Nature Center
places.why: Days.in.denver June favorite: easy mountain escape with interactive exhibits; pair with Colorow Mountain loop for a full morning.
places.toddler_notes: Short nature center visit + easy outdoor time; bring layers.
places.drive_note: ~32 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~9.6 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Denver Zoo
places.why: Days.in.denver June feature (130th anniversary programming) and fall Boo at the Zoo — classic toddler outing with stroller paths and animal viewing.
places.cost: Paid (library free zoo day prizes / SCFD free days when offered)
places.toddler_notes: Stroller-friendly; go early; shade/snack breaks essential.
places.drive_note: ~27 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~7.8 mi straight-line)

places.name: Centennial Center Park
places.address: 13050 E Peakview Ave area, Centennial, CO 80112
places.why: Days.in.denver June splash/park pick: renovated large splash pad, modern playground, space for all ages — easy full morning.
places.hours: Park dawn–dusk; splash pad seasonal (typically Memorial Day–Labor Day)
places.toddler_notes: Playground usable year-round; splash is summer-only.
places.drive_note: ~59 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~19.1 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Civic Green Park Splash Pad
places.address: Civic Green Park, Highlands Ranch, CO
places.why: Days.in.denver June pick: community park with playground and multiple fountain areas. Tip: arrive ~9:30 before water features turn on; parking tricky.
places.toddler_notes: Summer splash outing; playground year-round.
places.drive_note: ~57 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~18.2 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Red-tailed Hawk Park & Splash Pad
places.why: Days.in.denver July: one of the best metro splash pads paired with incredible inclusive playground — ziplines, musical play, accessible swings.
places.toddler_notes: Little shade — bring water, sunscreen. Inclusive features help mixed ages.
places.drive_note: ~76 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~24.7 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Pirates Cove Water Park
places.address: Pirates Cove Water Park, Englewood, CO 80110
places.why: Days.in.denver July & May: summer favorite with slides, lazy river, spray gardens, zero-depth entry for little swimmers — water-park vibes without the huge price tag.
places.toddler_notes: Zero-depth + spray gardens for toddlers. Arrive at open for chairs.
places.drive_note: ~41 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~12.8 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Surfside Spray Park
places.why: Days.in.denver July: colorful spray features, dumping buckets, space to run and splash. Paid splash pad (~$2 residents / $4 non-residents cited).
places.toddler_notes: Simple splash outing for littles; seasonal.
places.drive_note: ~16 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~4.2 mi straight-line)

places.name: Cherry Creek Valley Ecological Park
places.address: Cherry Creek Valley Ecological Park, Centennial, CO
places.why: Days.in.denver May creek pick: hidden gem with sandy creek areas, wide open space. ~15-min walk from parking to creek.
places.toddler_notes: Bring carrier/stroller for the walk in; shallow creek toddling.
places.drive_note: ~67 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~21.6 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: O'Fallon Park
places.why: Days.in.denver May creek pick: mountain escape with shady picnic spots and calm shallow creek with natural pools. Pair with downtown Evergreen.
places.toddler_notes: Stay-awhile creek day; farther mountain drive.
places.drive_note: ~48 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~15.0 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Yetman Farms
places.why: Days.in.denver Sept spotlight & Oct Little Farmers Storytime: urban farm ~15 min from downtown — goats, horses, chickens, barn cats; fall festival with pumpkins, cider, live music. Storytime ~$13–15.
places.cost: Varies by event (storytime ~$13–15; fall fest ~$8, under 2 free cited)
places.toddler_notes: Animal meet + farm storytime excellent for ~20 months.
places.drive_note: ~25 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~7.2 mi straight-line)

places.name: Hudson Gardens
places.address: 6115 S Santa Fe Dr, Littleton, CO 80120
places.why: Days.in.denver Oct library adventure: browse Hudson Gardens covered in thousands of pumpkins in early morning (free daytime; evening Magic of the Jack O’Lanterns ticketed), then Bemis Public Library for reading/play.
places.hours: Daytime garden hours vary; fall evenings for ticketed glow events
places.cost: Daytime often free / low cost; evening events ticketed
places.toddler_notes: Morning pumpkin stroll = low-key toddler outing.
places.drive_note: ~44 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~13.7 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Anythink Wright Farms Library
places.why: Days.in.denver Oct: start at this library (coffee spot on site) then head to Maize in the City for corn mazes and fall fun. Great library + adventure pairing.
places.toddler_notes: Indoor library play/storytime + nearby fall attractions.
places.drive_note: ~35 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~10.7 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Anythink Nature Library
places.why: Days.in.denver August: grand opening of 15-acre nature library — trails, interactive outdoor spaces, connect with nature. Ongoing visit destination.
places.toddler_notes: Nature + library combo; outdoor toddling on trails.
places.drive_note: ~27 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~8.0 mi straight-line)

places.name: Denver Central Library
places.why: Days.in.denver: Build/Make/Create Sundays; Oct Trick-or-Treat Street; museum & culture passes via DPL card (June hack). Pair with Civic Center / chalk fest area.
places.cost: Free; museum passes free/discounted with card
places.toddler_notes: Children's area + free programs; reserve museum passes early in the month.
places.drive_note: ~23 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~6.6 mi straight-line)

places.name: Girl Scout DreamLab
places.why: Days.in.denver August: 'one of Denver's coolest hidden gems' — bouldering wall, Camp DreamLab, podcast recording, rotating hands-on activities.
places.toddler_notes: Some activities better for older preschool+; still a unique indoor/outdoor exploratory stop.
places.drive_note: ~37 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~11.5 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Colorado Railroad Museum
places.why: Days.in.denver Sept: Day Out With Thomas weekends; year-round train museum with outdoor exhibits kids can explore. Golden outing.
places.hours: Typically daily; Thomas events seasonal weekends
places.toddler_notes: Trains fascinate toddlers; outdoor grounds for toddling.
places.drive_note: ~22 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~6.3 mi straight-line)

places.name: Denver Botanic Gardens Chatfield Farms
places.address: 8500 W Deer Creek Canyon Rd, Littleton, CO 80128
places.why: Days.in.denver Fall guide & Sept: corn maze celebrating Colorado 150th; Pumpkin Festival; trails and farm feel. Kids 3–15 free some 2nd Saturdays in summer (per Gardens).
places.toddler_notes: Mini maze options for littles; stroller on paved paths.
places.drive_note: ~52 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~16.5 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Four Mile Historic Park
places.why: Days.in.denver April: egg hunt / farm-feel historic park with animals, tractor rides, grounds to explore — year-round historic park visits beyond seasonal events.
places.cost: Admission for some programs; grounds may have fees
places.toddler_notes: Animals + open space; check event calendar.
places.drive_note: ~32 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~9.8 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Spano's Greenhouse and Farm
places.address: North Denver / Spano's Greenhouse and Farm
places.why: Days.in.denver Fall guide: charming neighborhood pumpkin patch with straw maze and farm stand — 'perfect for toddlers and preschoolers who don't need all-day activities.' Kids under 10 free (cited).
places.toddler_notes: Low-key fall outing near north Denver — ideal scale for ~20 months.
places.drive_note: ~23 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~6.6 mi straight-line)

places.name: Maize in the City
places.why: Days.in.denver Fall guide & Oct library pairing: giant corn maze, pumpkins, kid-friendly attractions — easy full fall day; pair with Anythink Wright Farms.
places.toddler_notes: Pick simpler attractions for toddlers; stroller on main paths.
places.drive_note: ~38 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~11.7 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Nick's Garden Center
places.why: Days.in.denver Fall guide & Oct: thousands of pumpkins, free straw maze/photo ops, breakfast burritos; pay wristband for tractor rides etc. Pair with Aurora Mission Viejo Library (~2 mi).
places.cost: Free admission; pay per activity / ~$20 wristband
places.toddler_notes: Go early for fewer crowds; free maze works for littles.
places.drive_note: ~59 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~18.8 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Bad Dog Farm (apple picking)
places.why: Days.in.denver Fall guide: local apple picking without leaving the metro — heirloom varieties by reservation. Tip: book ahead.
places.toddler_notes: Short orchard toddle; reservation required.
places.drive_note: ~25 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~7.4 mi straight-line)

places.name: Tagawa Gardens
places.why: Days.in.denver Sept: Lil’ Buds Book Club (first Thursday) story time with plants/animals/crafts in the 'Park' on Aisle 3 (ages 3–5). Fall Family Weekend with music, animals, carriage rides.
places.toddler_notes: Story club skews 3–5 but garden wander works for younger with caregiver.
places.drive_note: ~58 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~18.7 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Eloise May Library (Arapahoe Libraries)
places.why: Days.in.denver March: Toddler Story time Mondays 9:30 (ages 2–3) and Family Story time 10:30 (ages 0–5).
places.toddler_notes: Family story time includes 0–5 — good for ~20 months.
places.drive_note: ~41 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~12.7 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Stanley Marketplace (Tattered Cover story time)
places.why: Days.in.denver May: Tattered Cover story time Wed 11am & Sun 12pm at Stanley Marketplace — grab Logan House coffee and let kids play out back.
places.toddler_notes: Indoor/outdoor marketplace outing with play space.
places.drive_note: ~37 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~11.3 mi straight-line) — FARTHER (>30 min; flag)

places.name: Mines Museum (Golden)
places.why: Days.in.denver Oct: Mines Museum Spooktacular — free teal-pumpkin-friendly trick-or-treat with STEM hands-on activities. Museum also visit-worthy year-round for geology/minerals curiosity.
places.toddler_notes: Short museum visit; seasonal free Halloween event is toddler-friendly.
places.drive_note: ~28 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~8.2 mi straight-line)

places.name: City Park (Farmers Market + Jazz lawn)
places.address: 17th Ave & York St area, Denver, CO 80205
places.why: Days.in.denver: Saturday City Park Farmers Market (through Oct), Sunday City Park Jazz in summer — picnic lawn near Zoo/DMNS. Easy combine with Nature Play.
places.hours: Park dawn–dusk; market Sat mornings seasonally
places.toddler_notes: Wide lawns for toddling; stroller-friendly paths.
places.drive_note: ~27 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~7.8 mi straight-line)

places.name: Homegrown Tap & Dough (Arvada)
places.address: Olde Town / Arvada Homegrown location, Arvada, CO
places.why: Days.in.denver April: free arcade games for kids while you grab dinner — Arvada location among several metro spots.
places.cost: Food purchase; arcade free for kids (per Days.in.denver)
places.toddler_notes: Near-home dinner + toddler distraction; supervise arcade area.
places.drive_note: ~8 min drive from Arvada 80004 (~0.1 mi straight-line)
